newsitem.title: USA: Playboy to launch networks in Latin America.
newsitem.headline: Playboy to launch networks in Latin America.

text.p: Playboy Entereprises Inc. said Tuesday it was joining with Cisneros Television Group to launch two new television networks, Playboy TV/Latin America and AdulTVision/Latin America.
Both services will be part of a new venture called Playboy TV Latin America LLC.
Cisneros Television Group is a division of the Cisneros Group of Cos., which owns and operates television stations throughout Latin America.
Cisneros holds an 81 percent stake in the new venture. Playboy holds the remaining 19 percent and has an option to buy up to an additional 30 percent stake.
Playboy, a media and entertainment company, also will get license fees for the programming and royalty fees for use of the Playboy brand name for pay television.
Playboy and AdulTVision initially will be offered on an exclusive basis by Galaxy Latin America, a 144-channel direct-to-home satellite service.
Playboy said the new network will complement its international networks in Britain and Japan.
Playboy's stock fell 25 cents to $12.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
